title: War Hulk
summary: Start: enter Gyre. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the ambush sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. The ambush holds inside the Swallow until a keel crosses that line. A kite circles the teeth. The Swallow recovery is the separate salvage short. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside War Hulk's shell. The slate grants one keel salvage. With that salvage aboard, the Swallow recovery can file. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
